conf.description: hashicorp-vault audit / other (jsonx/XML audit device): targeted-tag regex extraction of the 12 representative fields this work order tables, plus a bounded regex-loop decode of the one-level request.data/response.data XML children into the same custom field shape the json feed's field names use. No whitelisted function parses generic XML - serde's live schema (GET /api/v1/functions/serde) has no xml type - so this is NOT a general XML decoder, only the known, schema-stable jsonx element names.

conf.comment: hashicorp-vault / audit / other (jsonx). jsonx renders the identical json audit schema as same-named XML elements, same nesting. No whitelisted XML processor exists (serde's live type enum is auto/csv/elff/clf/kvp/json/delim/regex/grok, confirmed via GET), so this implements the shape natively: one regex_extract per known leaf tag (time/type/error/display_name/entity_id/id/operation/path/mount_type/remote_address/remote_port/client_certificate_serial_number), then a bounded code regex loop over the one-level <data> children for request.data/response.data (a flat k/v map, never deeply nested). Generic leaf names (id/type/time/error) are only proven unique within this reduced field table, not the full schema - flagged in README. auth.policy_results.allowed-derived event.outcome is Elastic-only, not attempted here. Direct route, no guard hop.

raw XML blob of response.data's one-level children, scoped to the <response> block; absent on request records
